label: ercot115 coal marginal hr
definition: ERCOT-115: the ERCOT KEEPER as of 2026-07-26 (promoted on owner sign-off, superseding 2026-07-23-ercot100-netrev-margin-keeper). coal_econ_marginal_hr_bound is now the ERCOT backcast default; the global ScenarioConfig default stays False so PJM/MISO/NEISO adopt it in their own lanes (rule 25). The single delta over the outgoing keeper: the floor clamps each coal class's ECONOMIC offer band up to the ISO's own measured CAMPD marginal heat rate, lifting COAL_PRB.econ_low 0.400 -> 0.886 and retiring a fitted value with no measurement behind it (rules 13/26). Solved full-span in one invocation, years sequential. Coal 64.02->59.34 / 60.46->57.32 / 62.59->60.29 TWh (2023/2024/2025), the displaced coal landing in GAS — which moves to within 0.1-1.0 TWh of actual in every year, from 2.2-3.7 TWh under — with total generation preserved to 0.01 TWh. REMOVES a free parameter rather than adding one: DOF ledger offer_curve_by_group drops 112 -> 111 residual-identified scalars, the band becoming a measured-physical entry with lineage_solves 0 (rule 23). Cleared all five pre-committed criteria (PRECOMMIT-ercot115-coal-floor-promotion-2026-07-26.md, written and pushed BEFORE the solve) and its rubric profile is IDENTICAL to the outgoing keeper's (scored 9, target_grade 6, fails 3, C1 16/16 free 12/12, C7 shape + C8 forced_share PASS). Determination remains NOT-YET: C3a/C3b/C3c still FAIL and C6 governance stays UNATTESTED (8 residual-identified DOF entries remain — like-for-like with the keeper). COSTS ON THE RECORD: on the pinned load-weighted basis only 2023 improves, C3a 2024 +0.2 -> +1.3 and 2025 +0.7 -> +1.5 DEGRADE (inside the 2.0 pp tolerance); and the SHOULDER degrades (Feb-Apr coal ratio 0.59-0.83) while Jun-Sep stays 1.09-1.25, so this uniform offer-level change buys summer at the shoulder's expense and leaves the ~19 pp seasonal term untouched. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-ercot115-coal-floor-promotion-2026-07-26.md.
